title: Gyeongbokgung
limitations: Exterior reconstruction of the principal palace courts, the island pavilion and the lake banquet hall. Additional service yards and outlying perimeter halls continue to use PMTiles.
Carved animals, painted brackets and grilles are interpreted from photographs. Building datums follow the standard Terrarium samples.
The lake and island use native map and terrain data. The island footbridge remains closed to public access in the source map.
